pick.name: GitHub-native + OSS scanners in Actions (Dependabot, Semgrep CE, Gitleaks, OSV-Scanner, zizmor)
pick.what: Dependency, SAST, secret and workflow scanning for $0
pick.why: Dependabot is free on all plans; CodeQL/secret scanning free on public repos; OSS scanners cover private repos
pick.free_limits: GitHub Secret Protection ($19/committer) and Code Security ($30/committer) for PRIVATE repos need Team/Enterprise; free on public. OSS tools unlimited.
pick.install: pipx install semgrep zizmor; gitleaks: brew install gitleaks (macOS/Linux) or winget install Gitleaks.Gitleaks (Windows) or the gitleaks Docker image; osv-scanner: go install github.com/google/osv-scanner/v2/cmd/osv-scanner@latest. In CI use the official Actions pinned to SHAs.
pick.license: Semgrep LGPL-2.1; Gitleaks MIT; OSV-Scanner Apache-2.0; zizmor MIT

alts.name: Trivy
alts.free_limits: Unlimited; trivy-action tags were hijacked 2026-03-19/20 (TeamPCP) and malicious v0.69.5/6 images pushed 2026-03-22; pin SHAs / >=0.35.0 action

alts.name: Keep core repos public
alts.what: Open-core repos get CodeQL + secret scanning + push protection free

candidates.name: Trivy

decision: Dependabot + Semgrep + Gitleaks + OSV-Scanner + zizmor in one workflow covers deps, code, secrets and Actions hardening at $0. The 2026 Trivy/trivy-action compromise is why every action must be SHA-pinned (zizmor flags this).

verify.note: Install line is Windows-only (winget). Give a cross-platform form.
